item.title: EplayerX 1.2.17
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 播放视频、首页隐藏或窗口不可见时暂停首页自动轮播，减少后台活动。 - 改善继续观看的刷新与合并，减少重复处理，保持服务器和账号切换后的记录一致。 - 云盘媒体库支持保存分类排序偏好，首页与媒体库使用一致的排序。 - 改善剧集年份识别与上映日期信息，提升媒体匹配和排序的准确性。 - 改善字幕、解码异常恢复和播放切换的稳定性。
已知问题：系统下载服务异常失效后，下载任务可能停滞。可尝试完全退出并重新打开应用后重试。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Home auto-advance now pauses during video playback and while Home or its window is hidden, reducing background activity. - Improved continue-watching refresh and merging, reducing duplicate work and keeping records consistent when switching servers or accounts. - Cloud media libraries now remember category sorting preferences, with consistent sorting across Home and library views. - Improved TV series year recognition and release-date metadata for more accurate media matching and sorting. - Improved subtitle handling, decoder-error recovery, and playback switching stability.
Known issue: downloads may stall after the system download service invalidates its session. If this happens, try quitting and reopening the app before retrying.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
